authorization: 用户：总预算至少2h。这是一个长任务，每隔1h唤醒一次。当前训练方式布局模型基本持平或超过E90；未达成则终止；达成后冻结布局模型，自主研究可复用修正模型，期望最终Q<1.01，Loss尽量复用非reference部分。
layout_model: random E74 architecture192x12, all trainable; exact32k, two-stage E92 v1

budgets.scope: only E92 and conditionally new corrector study; no historical run resurrection
budgets.wall_accounting: training includes load/monitor/checkpoint/handoff/resume; check/preparation/evaluation charge full wall to separate task ledger; do not reset on wake or resume

qualification.selection: unique F own-Loss best only; no Q reselect; no phase switch by Q
qualification.panel: same fixed v6 dev_monitor500 and same E90 flash parameters; dev2000 draft corroboration
qualification.interpretation: Exploratory engineering near-parity: Loss within2%, weightedQ tolerance+.001; maxQ+5%, coverage pass-2pp and worst coverage p95+3pp guards. Report worker-paired uncertainty; passing a point tolerance does not prove statistical equivalence. Tolerances must not change after seeing new terminal.
qualification.if_fail: Stop all new work in this task, preserve evidence, close heartbeat; do not start corrector or retrain to chase Q
qualification.if_pass: Freeze qualified layout model/hash/data/config, then begin corrector design and registered training

corrector.contract: problem+good draft -> simultaneous global draft; same parameters reused n times; no autoregression or hidden legalizer
corrector.data: drafts generated by qualified frozen layout net on train only; freeze source hash; dev separate; tests sealed
corrector.loss: reuse non-reference overlap/task expressions and initial adopted relative scaling; no original-reference main supervision; draft-respect regularizer if needed must be fixed and registered
corrector.selection: one fixed objective within run, identical backward/monitors/best/LR/early stop; pure neural outputs separate from frozen postprocessor
corrector.iteration_rule: register train-unroll and deployed n before terminal; evaluate recurrence drift, topology retention and harms; no Q-based n selection
corrector.preflight: at most5 cases actual updates/finite guards/restore before each genuinely new algorithm

final_target.quality_basis: same fixed development panel neutral runtime; not official unseen contest score

corrector.budget_stop: If conditional corrector budget is exhausted without target, stop, report best frozen evidence and unmet goal; do not silently allocate more

execution_notes: Current P weights/Adam/RNG/epoch/cursor retained across budget-only migration; no retrain or LR reset.
Before future qualification code is added under qualification/, bind its own source snapshot; it is excluded from training-only source identity because it is not imported by training.
Source/config/budget migration snapshots and exact-state audit are in runs/budget2h_extension.
On unchanged/nonactionable heartbeat stay quiet; notify on important change/completion/failure/required decision.

Prepare same100 reference/layout/E90 draft figures without rating controls at layout qualification; after a corrector, use reference/layout/corrector/final four stages with same module IDs and axes. Shared visualization only; no Q-based image filtering.
next_action: No further automatic training/evaluation/corrector research; await a new explicit user request
completion_reason: Registered E90 quality gates failed; mean Loss passed but weighted Q, max Q and draft-coverage tails failed
